themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints spiked to 51 THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 14.1 per week—a 261% increase (z-score: 7.29)—suggesting rapid deterioration of road surfaces across Sunset Park, potentially exacerbated by recent winter weather or deferred maintenance.
evidence: 51 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 14.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 7.29 (well above 2.0 threshold for statistical significance)
3-month baseline includes 300 total street condition complaints—this one week represents 17% of that volume
reporting_angles: Visual ground truthing: photograph worst-affected blocks and map complaint clusters
Interview residents about specific hazards (potholes, broken curbs) causing complaints THIS WEEK
DOT budget/maintenance schedules—did crews reduce activity or is winter damage backlog overwhelming response capacity?

themes_detail.label: Building Code/Use Violations Surge
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use complaints surged to 34 THIS WEEK—up 533% from the 8-week average of 5.4 per week (z-score: 10.13)—indicating a sudden wave of code violations, illegal conversions, or occupancy issues likely tied to new construction or rapid occupant turnover.
evidence: 34 Building/Use complaints THIS WEEK vs. 5.4 weekly baseline
549 DOB permits filed in past 90 days (385 alterations, 42 new buildings)—activity surge may be generating violations
reporting_angles: FOIL 311 complaint details: what specific violations (illegal apartments, overcrowding, fire safety) are being reported?
Cross-reference with DOB violation records and recent permit activity—are new construction projects triggering complaints?
Interview DOB and HPD on inspection response times; connect to broader 'housing crisis' with illegal conversions to meet demand

themes_detail.label: Sewer System Backup Emergencies
themes_detail.summary: Sewer complaints jumped to 11 THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 2.9 per week—a 283% spike (z-score: 5.29)—suggesting acute blockages, overflow, or system stress affecting multiple blocks in Sunset Park.
evidence: 11 sewer complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.9 weekly average (383% volume increase)
Contextual baseline: water system complaints also elevated at 299 over 90 days, suggesting broader water infrastructure stress
reporting_angles: Map THIS WEEK's sewer complaints geographically—are they clustered in one area (single main break) or dispersed?
Interview DEP on emergency response; has a pipe break occurred, or is this weather/aging infrastructure?
Connect to longer-term infrastructure investment requests from Community Board (repeated budget requests for transit/facility upgrades)

themes_detail.label: Construction Lead Dust Health Risk
themes_detail.summary: Construction lead dust complaints hit 3 LAST WEEK—a 1100% spike from 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 6.35)—indicating unsafe lead remediation practices or uncontrolled renovation activity in residential areas, creating pediatric health exposure risks.
evidence: 3 lead dust complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (1100% increase)
549 recent DOB permits filed (385 alterations on existing buildings likely to contain lead); permits may lack proper containment enforcement
reporting_angles: Identify specific buildings generating complaints; verify DOB/HPD enforcement and lead abatement certifications
Expert interview: pediatrician or environmental health specialist on cumulative lead exposure in kids near construction sites
Probe: Are contractors following EPA RRP Rule? Is HPD/DOB adequately inspecting renovation sites for lead safety?

themes_detail.label: Rodent Infestation Acceleration
themes_detail.summary: Rodent complaints jumped to 15 LAST WEEK—up 314% from the 3.6 weekly baseline (z-score: 5.37)—suggesting a rapid infestation surge, likely linked to unsanitary condition complaints (230 over 90 days) and possible sanitation service gaps.
evidence: 15 rodent complaints LAST WEEK vs. 3.6 weekly average (314% increase)
Contextual support: 230 unsanitary condition complaints and 229 dirty condition complaints over 90 days suggest sanitation system stress
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY about collection frequency/changes in Sunset Park—has service been cut or delayed?
Resident testimonies: which blocks are worst affected? Are restaurants/buildings in violation contributing?
Health department follow-up: Has rat-borne illness been detected? Are schools or daycare centers affected?
